def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cells=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]]
    def try_diag(p):
        seq={}
        for r,c,v in cells:
            k=(c-r)%p
            if k in seq and seq[k]!=v: return None
            seq[k]=v
        if len(seq)<p: return None
        return [[seq[(c-r)%p] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    def try_vert(p):
        seq={}
        for r,c,v in cells:
            k=r%p
            if k in seq and seq[k]!=v: return None
            seq[k]=v
        if len(seq)<p: return None
        return [[seq[r%p] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    for p in range(1, max(h,w)+1):
        o=try_diag(p)
        if o: return o
    for p in range(1, h+1):
        o=try_vert(p)
        if o: return o
    return g
